label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Glad
to
see
you.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_02
text: You feeling rested and recovered after our big\nadventure down in the underdepths?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_03
text: Oh, youth really is an enviable thing!\c\nI’m still feeling all wrung out despite having\nbeen back for a while now![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_04
text: Really? I thought you’d be all chipper by now.\nYouth is on your side, after all![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_05
text: But on to why I called you here. Since our return,\nI’ve been writing up everything we discovered on\r\nour expedition. Honestly, I’ve hardly slept![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_06
text: I obtained Geeta’s permission to turn it all into a\nbook, but don’t worry—I’ve made sure to skip a\r\nfew details and omit the names of those involved.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_07
text: So voilà! A proof copy of the book, freshly\ndelivered from my publisher, just for you.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_08
text: I behaved recklessly in the underdepths. I don’t\nknow what we would’ve done if it weren’t for you.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_09
text: You truly deserve a copy of this book—I just\nhope it’s sufficient as an apology.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_10
text:
Ah! But there was something else I needed to
check with you...\c
Would you mind showing me your Tera Orb,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_11
text: Hmm, I thought as much. It’s behaving just like\nKieran’s and Carmine’s orbs...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_12
text: I think it might be because your orbs were\ndirectly exposed to the energy from Terapagos.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_13
text: Kieran and Carmine say that ever since the\nunderdepths, they’ve been able to Terastallize\r\ntheir Pokémon without charging their Tera Orbs.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_14
text: Actually, there’s one more piece of news I should\nshare with you related to those deepest depths![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_15
text: You know the Terarium Core that hangs from the\nceiling of the Terarium?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_16
text: Well, until now, I’d been keeping it topped up\nwith a mixture of Paldean soil and water from\r\nthe Crystal Pool in Kitakami.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_17
text: That’s how we’ve been able to stabilize the\nTerastal phenomenon on our academy grounds.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_18
text: But the other day, I tried adding crystals I’d\ncollected from the underdepths to that mix—and\r\nit caused the properties of the core to change![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_19
text: The result? Pokémon shining in rainbow colors\nhave started appearing all over the Terarium!\r\nAnd they have the Stellar Tera Type![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_20
text: Thanks to this, my research into the Terastal\nphenomenon is shining brighter than ever![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_23
text: Oh, and there was one last thing...\c\nA man in a blue suit was looking for you over by\nthe entrance to the academy.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_21
text: That’s all I have to report for now! Thanks for\nsetting aside some time to chat.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0370_bbteacher_22
text:
I’m off to pay a visit to my publisher, so I’ll leave
you to it.\c
Next time we meet, I’ll ask you for a good long
look at Terapagos. Till then![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
